title: CY50007: Chemistry Of Natural Products
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Chemistry of selected natural products. Special emphasis on the synthesis of
steroids, terpenes, alkaloids, pheromones, prostaglandins, macrolides and
polyether antibiotics. Selected topics from the current literature.
